question: Should OpenClaw adopt this persistent AI-safety telemetry taxonomy and public plugin emission contract in core, and if so what minimum event, retention, and authorization scope is acceptable?
rationale: This decision establishes durable operator data and a compatibility-sensitive plugin API; code review cannot safely select the long-term product and security boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor a narrowed core contract
options.body: Approve a minimal core event schema and storage/query policy, with plugin permissions and retention explicitly specified before the branch is narrowed to that contract.

options.title: Keep the core seam internal
options.body: Retain only generic diagnostics hooks in core and move taxonomy-specific exporters, UI, and third-party integrations into plugins after the required extension seam is designed.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause this PR until the open feature proposal receives a maintainer-sponsored design decision and security review.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrowed core contract
recommendation.body: Approve a minimal core event schema and storage/query policy, with plugin permissions and retention explicitly specified before the branch is narrowed to that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed contributor attached to the active implementation series; a repository product owner should be added during maintainer triage.
